bias.zh: 反弹 · 突破 $394.4，仍低于 10 和 200 日均线

read.en: TSMC rose 2.0% on Nov 10 to $396.48, trading $387.20–400.21. It is above the 5-day ($381.9) and below the 10-day ($399.0), 30-day ($428.5), 100-day ($426.6) and 200-day ($402.1); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 9, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($415.73), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: 台积电 11月10日上涨 2.0%，收于 $396.48，盘中区间 $387.20–400.21。股价位于 5 日（$381.9）均线上方，10 日（$399.0）、30 日（$428.5）、100 日（$426.6）和 200 日（$402.1）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月9日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$415.73），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close cleared the $394.4 Nov 9 high, now support, but the $400.21 high stalled between the 10-day ($399.0) and 200-day ($402.1). Resistance is $398.3–402.1 (Nov 2 low, 10 and 200-day), then $410.6 (Nov 4 high) and $415.7 (SAR). Support is $387.2–394.4, then $380.3–381.9 (Nov 9 low, 5-day) and $372.7. A close above $402.1 would target $410–416; below $387.2, $380–382.
